description:
Since 2019, US export controls have blocked Huawei from accessing the world's most advanced chip-making equipment. Despite this, Huawei just announced a 53% jump in chip density using a novel chip design approach called LogicFolding. 

Proving that once again, "necessity is the mother of invention"

Thanks for Huawei for inviting me to this exciting announcement and for sponsoring this video. All opinions, content, and editorial outputs are my own
